title: miRBioGenAtlas: Pan-cancer alteration landscape of the miRNA biogenesis machinery
description: Curated copy-number-alteration and somatic-mutation frequency tables for 15 miRNA biogenesis pathway genes across 32 TCGA PanCancer Atlas tumour types (n = 10,195 samples), retrieved via the cBioPortal public API, with a reproducible Python retrieval pipeline and an R figure-generation script. Data files are licensed CC BY 4.0; analysis code is licensed MIT (see LICENSE and LICENSE-data).
